component.name: linscp
component.summary: Transfer files to and from servers

description.p: linscp transfers files between your computer and remote servers over SFTP, SCP, FTP (with TLS), WebDAV and S3. Its two-panel interface shows local and remote files side by side, with the same sessions, settings and scripting on Linux and Windows.
It synchronizes and compares directories, keeps a remote directory up to date, edits remote files, and runs commands on the server.

description.p: A maintenance release that cleans up the continuous integration. It brings no new features.
The first stable release. The About dialog and the links to the manual, the homepage, donations and security reports now go to linscp.org, and the Help menu can report a security issue.
A maintenance release with internal fixes. The interface is unchanged.

Completes the interface. The Site Manager gains its context menus, site search, colours, notes and every advanced page, and transfers show elapsed and remaining time, can be limited in speed or moved to the background. Preferences can be searched.
The menus and dialogs are translated into 53 languages. They follow the language chosen in Preferences, or the --lang option.
Adds the Explorer interface, with a single panel, a folder tree and an address bar. The remaining Preferences pages arrive, among them a light, dark or automatic theme.

Completes the Commander menus with thumbnails, the command line, queue commands, links and tab colours. Adds a portable mode and fixes the update check on Linux. Every protocol is now tested against real servers.

The first published version: SFTP, SCP, FTP and FTPS, WebDAV and S3, with saved sites, workspaces and session tabs. It has the two-panel interface, queued transfers, synchronization, an internal editor and linscp-cli for scripting.
